config.name: How to read this dashboard
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT 1 AS x FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) LIMIT 1
config.markdown:
**KubeArmor: is the enforcer up, and what did it catch.** The top row is health (DaemonSet on every node, relay/controller/operator available, restarts); the rest is alerts.

Alerts are the JSON lines `kubearmor-relay-server` prints when `enableStdOutAlerts` is on in the `KubeArmorConfig`; the gateway parses them into `LogAttributes` (`PolicyName`, `Action`, `Operation`, ...). **`Action = Audit` is what `Block` would have refused**, so it is the number to drive to zero before switching a posture or a policy to enforce. Default-posture hits show as `PolicyName = DefaultPosture`. Alerts are throttled to 10/s per node (`maxAlertPerSec`), so a flood is under-counted, never over-counted. Visibility logs (`enableStdOutLogs`) are deliberately not shipped: with `process,network` visibility on every pod they would dwarf every other log in the cluster.

config.name: Components degraded
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    if(ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', 'DaemonSet', 'Deployment') AS kind,
    if(kind = 'DaemonSet', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name']) AS name,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.desired', 'k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes')) AS desired,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.available', 'k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes')) AS ready
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.desired', 'k8s.deployment.available', 'k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes', 'k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes')
    AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY kind, name
)
SELECT countIf(ready < desired) AS "Degraded" FROM w WHERE name != ''

config.name: Restarts in range
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toUInt32(sum(d)) AS "Restarts"
FROM (
  SELECT greatest(0, max(Value) - min(Value)) AS d
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name']
)

config.name: Alerts
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

config.name: Would block (Audit)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND LogAttributes['Action'] = 'Audit'
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

config.name: Blocked
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')

config.name: KubeArmor errors/warnings
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Lines"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor'
  AND NOT mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('warn', 'warning', 'error', 'fatal', 'critical')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)

config.name: Components
config.sqlTemplate:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT
    if(ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'] != '', 'DaemonSet', 'Deployment') AS kind,
    if(kind = 'DaemonSet', ResourceAttributes['k8s.daemonset.name'], ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name']) AS name,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.desired', 'k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes')) AS desired,
    argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.available', 'k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes')) AS ready
  FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
  WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.deployment.desired', 'k8s.deployment.available', 'k8s.daemonset.desired_scheduled_nodes', 'k8s.daemonset.ready_nodes')
    AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
  GROUP BY kind, name
)
SELECT
  kind AS "Kind",
  name AS "Workload",
  if(ready >= desired, 'ok', 'DEGRADED') AS "Status",
  toUInt32(desired) AS "Desired",
  toUInt32(ready) AS "Ready"
FROM w
WHERE name != ''
ORDER BY "Status" ASC, "Workload" ASC

config.name: Containers
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS "Pod",
  ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS "Container",
  if(countIf(MetricName = 'k8s.container.ready') = 0, '', if(argMaxIf(Value, TimeUnix, MetricName = 'k8s.container.ready') = 1, 'ready', 'NOT READY')) AS "Ready",
  toUInt32(greatest(0, maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts') - minIf(Value, MetricName = 'k8s.container.restarts'))) AS "Restarts",
  round(avgIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage'), 3) AS "CPU avg (cores)",
  round(maxIf(Value, MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set') / 1048576) AS "Memory peak (MiB)"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName IN ('k8s.container.ready', 'k8s.container.restarts', 'container.cpu.usage', 'container.memory.working_set')
  AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY "Pod", "Container"
HAVING "Container" != ''
ORDER BY "Restarts" DESC, "Pod" ASC

config.name: Alerts by action
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, LogAttributes['Action'] AS "Action", sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, "Action"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Alerts by namespace
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(Timestamp) AS ts, LogAttributes['NamespaceName'] AS "Namespace", sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY ts, "Namespace"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Policies hit
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  LogAttributes['PolicyName'] AS "Policy",
  LogAttributes['Action'] AS "Action",
  LogAttributes['Operation'] AS "Operation",
  sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts",
  uniqExact(LogAttributes['NamespaceName']) AS "Namespaces",
  max(Timestamp) AS "Last seen"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY "Policy", "Action", "Operation"
ORDER BY "Alerts" DESC
LIMIT 100

config.name: Who triggers them
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT
  LogAttributes['NamespaceName'] AS "Namespace",
  LogAttributes['PodName'] AS "Pod",
  LogAttributes['ProcessName'] AS "Process",
  sum(greatest(toUInt64OrZero(LogAttributes['log_count']), 1)) AS "Alerts",
  countIf(LogAttributes['Action'] = 'Block') AS "Blocked"
FROM default.otel_logs
WHERE ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] = 'kubearmor-relay-server' AND mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation')
  AND $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
GROUP BY "Namespace", "Pod", "Process"
ORDER BY "Alerts" DESC
LIMIT 100

config.name: Alerts
config.select: Timestamp, LogAttributes['NamespaceName'] AS namespace, LogAttributes['PodName'] AS pod, LogAttributes['PolicyName'] AS policy, LogAttributes['Action'] AS action, LogAttributes['Operation'] AS operation, LogAttributes['ProcessName'] AS process, LogAttributes['Resource'] AS resource, LogAttributes['Result'] AS result

config.name: CPU by container (cores)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS "Container", avg(Value) AS "Cores"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'container.cpu.usage' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, "Container"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Memory by container (MiB)
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS "Container", max(Value) / 1048576 AS "MiB"
FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge
WHERE MetricName = 'container.memory.working_set' AND ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
GROUP BY ts, "Container"
ORDER BY ts

config.name: KubeArmor warnings and errors
config.select: Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, ResourceAttributes['k8s.container.name'] AS container, SeverityText, Body
config.where: ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'] = 'kubearmor' AND NOT mapContains(LogAttributes, 'Operation') AND lower(SeverityText) IN ('warn', 'warning', 'error', 'fatal', 'critical')

config.name: Kubernetes events in kubearmor
config.select: Timestamp, JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'type') AS type, JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'reason') AS reason, JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'regarding', 'kind') AS kind, JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'regarding', 'name') AS object, JSONExtractString(Body, 'object', 'note') AS note
